changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpractitioner AS SELECT p.id, p.facility_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.email, p.phone_number, p.specialty, p.sub_specialty, p.default_medical_license, p.secondary_medical_license, p.educational_level, p.appointable, p.user_id, p.default_license_valid_until, p.secondary_license_valid_until, p.dob, p.job_role, p.gender, p.parallel_capacity_value, p.default_duration_minutes, p.default_buffer_before_minutes, p.default_buffer_after_minutes, p.is_active, p.created_date, p.created_by, p.last_modified_by, p.last_modified_date, p.working_days, p.national_number FROM public.practitioner p;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpractitioner TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpractitioner FROM report_user;
